landing.headline: Your business idea, open for orders today.
landing.subhead: Tell AxoriOS about your business. It builds your brand and your store, takes payments through PayPal and answers your customers.
landing.magicLinkSent: Check your email for your sign-in link.
landing.signInFailed: We couldn't sign you in. Check your details and try again.
landing.linkFailed: That sign-in link has expired. Ask for a new one.

builder.title: Build your store
builder.greeting: Tell me about your business: what you sell, where you are and what you charge. Any language works.
builder.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
builder.panelEmpty: Your store appears here once you describe your business.
builder.previewHint: Click any part of your store, then tell me what to change.

publishCard.title: Put your store online?
publishCard.body: Anyone with the link will be able to see your store and your prices. You can keep editing afterwards.
publishCard.denied: Not published. Your store is still private.

scheduleCard.title: Schedule these posts?
scheduleCard.bodyOne: 1 post will go out on your Telegram channel at:
scheduleCard.bodyMany: {count} posts will go out on your Telegram channel at:
scheduleCard.done: Scheduled. You can change this on the Marketing page.
scheduleCard.denied: Not scheduled. Your posts are still drafts.

shopifyCard.connectBody: AxoriOS will be able to add and change products and pages at {domain}.
shopifyCard.syncBody: Your products, a collection and your store's pages will be added to Shopify, or updated if they're already there.
shopifyCard.refused: That didn't work. See the message below.
shopifyCard.synced: Copied to Shopify: {products} products and {pages} pages.
shopifyCard.failed: The copy to Shopify didn't finish. Please try again.
shopifyCard.themeIntro: Shopify doesn't let apps change a theme's look. To match your brand, open the theme editor and use these:
shopifyCard.statusNone: Not connected. Ask in the chat to connect your Shopify store.

campaignCard.failed: Some posts couldn't be made. Please try again.

campaigns.title: Marketing
campaigns.empty: No posts yet. Ask for some in the chat: "Make me 3 posts for birthday season."
campaigns.caption: Caption
campaigns.noChannel: This store can't post automatically yet. Download the pack and post it yourself.
campaigns.failed: This post didn't go out. Check the time and try again.
campaigns.errorTime: Pick a time in the next 7 days.
campaigns.errorGeneric: That didn't work. Please try again.

productsCard.title: Your products
productsCard.editHint: Tell me a new price or another product to add.

defaults.contactBody: Message us to ask anything or to place an order.

cart.title: Your cart
cart.deliveryLabel: Who is this for, and where should it go?
cart.deliveryPlaceholder: Name, phone number and delivery address
cart.errorDelivery: Please tell us where to deliver your order.
cart.errorUnavailable: Something in your cart is no longer for sale. Please remove it and try again.
cart.errorStock: We don't have that many left. Please lower the quantity.
cart.errorCurrency: This store can't take payments yet. Please message the shop.
cart.errorGeneric: We couldn't start your payment. You haven't been charged. Please try again.

dashboard.title: Orders
dashboard.empty: No orders yet. They show here as soon as a customer pays.

order.paidTitle: Thank you. Your order is paid.
order.paidBody: The shop has your order and will be in touch about delivery.
order.confirmingBody: PayPal is still processing it. Refresh this page in a minute or two.
order.failedBody: You haven't been charged for this order. Please go back to the store and try again.
order.unpaidBody: If you've just paid, refresh this page. Otherwise, go back to the store to try again.

chat.welcome: Welcome to {store}! Tell me what you're looking for, in any language, and I'll help you order.
chat.noStore: Hello! I answer for the shops on AxoriOS. Please open this chat from a shop's page, using its Telegram button.
chat.storeClosed: Sorry, that shop isn't open right now. Please check the link with the shop.
chat.textOnly: Sorry, I can only read text messages for now. Please type what you need.
chat.busy: We're getting a lot of messages today. Please try again tomorrow, or order on the shop's page.
chat.failed: Sorry, something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a minute.
